title: Three more pictures of the Field house, checked against Hunt's own floor plan
items: 1905 Prairie, Marshall Field's house, is now compared with three more pictures: an 1880s photograph, the Chicago Daily News photograph of about 1905, and an 1893 engraving. Each has its camera worked out, and the model is drawn from the same viewpoint beside it.

Richard Morris Hunt's own plan of the house's main floor, from the Library of Congress, gives the front as 55 feet. Both photographs line up with that plan but not with the 1911 insurance map's 50 feet, and they show the walls about 6 feet lower than the model. Those differences are now recorded against each picture, ready to build.
